title: patch_file CRLF normalization incomplete in exact-string mode
description: Two patch_file calls failed with 'old_string not found' on Windows CRLF files in this run. moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize added normalize_line_endings but moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite replaced the diff engine with exact substring matching, which may not apply the same normalization. Result: patch_file is unreliable on Windows for files with CRLF endings, requiring write_file fallback on every affected file.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to verify and extend CRLF normalization to the exact-string matching path in patch_file.rs, ensuring both old_string and file content are normalized before the substring search.
